# Adrian Turbiński

> Freelance web developer from Wrocław, Poland. He builds web applications and websites for companies, audits and fixes accessibility against WCAG 2.1 AA and maintains existing apps, including older Angular versions. He works in Wrocław and Lower Silesia in person and remotely across Poland and the EU, in Polish and English, on a B2B invoice. He has built web applications since 2019, mostly in Angular, TypeScript, RxJS and Node.js.

- Senior front-end developer and tech lead. He led a small team, designed front-end and back-end architecture and built an app that models and visualizes high-voltage power lines.
- Clients talk to him directly from the quote through deployment to maintenance.
- Contact: adrian.turbinski@gmail.com, phone +48 731 985 567, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-turbi%C5%84ski-b266b21a6), [GitHub](https://github.com/adiyy2001), [Google Business Profile](https://www.google.com/search?q=Adrian+Turbi%C5%84ski+Wroc%C5%82aw).

## Services and prices

Starting prices, net of VAT, for a typical scope; an exact quote is written after a call. Hourly work: PLN 140 net.

- [Web applications](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/services/web-applications/): client portals, booking systems, internal tools; front end, back end and deployment; from PLN 18,000 net, 6 to 12 weeks
- [Websites](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/services/websites/): fast company sites with SEO basics, Google Business Profile and WCAG AA; from PLN 3,500 net, 2 to 4 weeks
- [WCAG accessibility](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/services/wcag-accessibility/): audits with keyboard and screen reader testing, a prioritized report, fixes, help with the European Accessibility Act; from PLN 1,900 net
- [Maintenance](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/services/maintenance/): updates, Angular migrations, bug fixes, backups and new features, also in code written by others; from PLN 300 net per month
- [All services](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/services/), [usługi po polsku](https://adrianturbinski.pl/uslugi/)

## Work

- [TailorCloth](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/tailorcloth/): a website on Odoo with custom product management modules for a tailoring company from Kraków, built with the team he led at Media Hunters; another agency maintains it today
- [flagtide](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/flagtide/): a self-hosted feature flag service, a Quarkus back end that pushes changes over WebSockets and an Angular SDK on npm; live demo, source on GitHub, measured numbers
- [gridtwin](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/gridtwin/): an educational digital twin of a small transmission network, an AC power flow checked against MATPOWER, a single-line diagram and a 3D substation in Angular, a Java and Quarkus back end; live demo and source on GitHub
- [coschema](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/coschema/): a real-time collaborative diagram editor in Angular with offline editing, per-user undo and a convergence simulator; live demo and source on GitHub
- [signal-timeline](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/signal-timeline/): undo and history for NgRx SignalStore, published on npm, with branches, jumping to any entry and cheap recording; live demo, source on GitHub, measured numbers
- [eventhorizon](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/eventhorizon/): a real-time ray tracer for light bent around a Schwarzschild black hole in WebGPU and WGSL, checked against a float64 reference; live demo, source on GitHub, measured numbers
- [fieldline](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/fieldline/): the electric and magnetic field around high-voltage lines computed on the GPU in WebGPU, with exposure contours and a phase-arrangement optimizer; live demo, source on GitHub, measured numbers
- [Sample websites](https://adrianturbinski.pl/wzornik/): nine websites for made-up businesses, each with its own typeface, palette and signature element; every page says the business is made up; in Polish, Kminek and Przęsło also in English
- [Projects](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/): the index of the work above
